effects.effect: You are trained in secret techniques from your order that allow you to discern the truth with [supernatural](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.general/supernatural) precision. If a creature is of a lower level than you, you automatically know when they are lying, though you don't necessarily know the actual truth behind their lie. Additionally, you gain an [edge](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/edge) on [tests](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.test/test) made to detect lies or hidden motives.
